'''Childress''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served in the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Stationed on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], Captain Childress was head of security at [[Tower command station|Waypoint Station Aurek]].

==Biography==
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], Childress rose to the rank of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] in the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] by the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. During the Cold War, he was stationed on the planet [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] as part of the [[Taris Resettlement Initiative]]'s military protection. He worked at [[Tower command station|Waypoint Station Aurek]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic's]] primary forward base in the [[rakghoul]]-infested territory outside of the resettlement zone, where he was head of security.<ref name="TOR" />

When a Republic-allied individual resolved a land claim dispute in [[Olaris]], Childress' subordinate [[Private/Legends|Private]] [[Sakal]] sent word to the captain that the individual would be wiling to help on another matter.<ref name="Claim">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|Reclaiming What's Ours|Taris}}</ref> Childress asked them to find a commando team he sent to the crashed ''[[Endar Spire]]'', the Republic ship destroyed by [[Darth Malak]] before the [[Destruction of Taris|bombardment]] in an effort to kill [[Bastila Shan]]. The team was escorting researchers who were attempting to recover the ''Spire''{{'s}} logs, which could prove invaluable in defending against an [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|orbital bombardment]] similar to the [[destruction of Taris]] or the [[Sacking of Coruscant]].

The individual traveled to the wreckage of the ''Spire'', where they aided [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Karlsu]]&mdash;the only survivor of Childress' fifth commando team&mdash;in ferrying the researchers past the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] forces and to the ship's computers. After the individual defeated the pirates, Karlsu told them that he would report their success to the captain.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Childress was created for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] released by [[BioWare]] on [[December 20]], [[2011]]. After Republic players have completed the Taris mission "Reclaiming What's Ours", Private Sakal asks them to talk to Childress at Waypoint Station Aurek. The captain gives the player the mission "Wake of the Spire", asking them to help the commando team inside of the ''Endar Spire''{{'s}} remains.<ref name="TOR" />
